title: New Update Available

sections.name: License connection
items: Packaged Brava builds now connect to the live license server instead of localhost.
Activation failures caused by an unreachable server now show a short, useful message.

sections.name: Updates
items: Brava now checks the hosted production update feed.
Missing or unavailable updates no longer expose internal error details in Settings.
Older installations can download the complete newest installer in one update.

instructions: Open Brava, go to Settings, check for updates, then select Update & restart.
